summary: Outputs skeletal joint positions and rotations from supported Nuitrack sensors.
key_concepts: CHOP channels carry skeleton tracking results.
Pair with Nuitrack TOP for image and depth streams.
common_gotchas: Requires a separate Nuitrack license and compatible sensor.
Joint rotations are absolute, not parent-relative.
Node creation alone does not prove sensor tracking.
Live 2025.33230 calls the user limit maxplayers; documentation may call it count.
platform_notes: Windows only; sensor, SDK and license must be verified on the target machine.
